lines.text: Europa League glory for {winnerClub}, and there's a European journey that ends with something worth holding.
lines.was: The Europa League belongs to {winnerClub}! A whole European campaign has led to this glorious prize.

lines.text: Tuck this moment away, {winner}. Continental titles are the kind of memories that never need polishing.
lines.was: There is a particular joy in this one, {winner}. Continental silverware, earned and carried home!

lines.text: From a competition full of ambition comes a champion, and {winnerClub} have taken their chance!
Look what {winner} has brought back from Europe! Not just a memory, but a title.
Read the name on this honour: {winnerClub}. The Europa League has found its new champion.
lines.was: Here is the reward for all that European ambition: {winnerClub} have lifted the Europa League!

lines.text: Here's a moment for {winner} to remember. European ambition has become a title, not just a promise.
lines.was: A continental title for {winner}, and suddenly this season has a beautiful new centrepiece.

lines.text: What a distinction for {winnerClub}: winners of the Europa League, and nobody can dispute that.
lines.was: Europe has delivered its verdict! {winnerClub} are Europa League winners, and that is a wonderful distinction.

lines.text: Somewhere in that trophy room, {winner} will be finding a very special place for this one.
No longer a European ambition for {winnerClub}; the Europa League is theirs, in silver and in history.
Watch this season take on a different shape. {winner} has written a European victory into it.
lines.was: Watch the meaning of this season change! {winner} has just added a European title to the story.

lines.text: At the end of that continental road, {winnerClub} stand with the prize they went looking for.
lines.was: The long road through Europe has ended with {winnerClub} holding the Europa League trophy. Magnificent!

lines.text: Steady hands, big ambition: {winner} has turned the Europa League challenge into a magnificent triumph.
lines.was: This is a continental triumph with {winner}'s name written all over it. What an achievement!

lines.text: Call the roll of European winners and add {winnerClub}. This is their moment in the competition's history.
lines.was: Out of the European chase comes a winner, and the name is {winnerClub}!

lines.text: A passport full of memories is fine, {winner}, but this is the souvenir that goes into the cabinet.
lines.was: For {winner}, the finest kind of souvenir from a European campaign: a trophy that stays forever.

lines.text: Try saying it without a smile: {winnerClub} have won the Europa League. That has a lovely ring.
lines.was: You can hear the pride in those words: {winnerClub}, winners of the Europa League!

lines.text: All the ambition in the world means little without the finish. {winner} has provided the finish.
lines.was: All that chasing, all that hope, and now {winner} has the European silver to show for it!

lines.text: Take it in, {winnerClub}. The Europa League winners' roll has a new name, and it's yours.
lines.was: Take a look at this moment for {winnerClub}. The Europa League has found its new champions!

lines.text: Now there's a different weight to this season. {winner} has lifted a trophy from Europe's stage.
lines.was: Now the cabinet has a European accent! {winner} has secured a prize with real continental weight.

lines.text: Across Europe this trophy commands respect, and {winnerClub} have earned the right to claim it.
Give {winner} the applause this deserves. A major continental honour is not something to hurry past.
lines.was: Give {winner} a moment to savour that! The Europa League is a serious addition to any season.

lines.text: Put a European trophy beside the badge and suddenly {winnerClub}'s season has a different meaning.
lines.was: The promise of European nights has become something solid for {winnerClub}: a continental title.

lines.text: Make some room, {winner}! That Europa League trophy is not a small parcel to bring home.
In the proudest part of the honours list, put {winnerClub} down as Europa League winners.
lines.was: One more line for the club's proudest pages: {winnerClub} have won a European competition!

lines.text: It's a fine thing to dream of silverware abroad; {winner} has gone and brought it back!
Seal the European chapter in bold. {winnerClub} have done the hard part and won the Europa League.
lines.was: What was once the target is now the prize in {winnerClub}'s hands. Europa League champions!

lines.text: European success has its own particular sound, and for {winner} tonight, it's the sound of triumph!
Put that European adventure in the books. {winnerClub} have written the closing line in silver.
lines.was: There goes the lid on the European campaign, and {winnerClub} have sealed it with a trophy!

lines.text: Borders are part of the adventure, but {winner} has brought the achievement right back home.
lines.was: A campaign crossing borders ends with a title for {winner}. There's something grand about that.

lines.text: Listen to that description of {winnerClub}: Europa League winners. It fits them rather nicely!
Not every European story gets a silver ending, but {winner} has written precisely that one.
Raise the curtain on the honours list: {winnerClub} have become Europa League champions.
lines.was: Here comes the continental reward! {winnerClub} have taken their place among Europa League champions.

lines.text: Nobody gets an advance promise of European glory. {winner} has gone and secured it.
lines.was: You might have hoped for a memorable European campaign; {winner} has delivered an unforgettable one!

lines.text: That name belongs in the European honours list now. {winnerClub} have won their place.
lines.was: The Europa League is heading into {winnerClub}'s story, and it won't be a passing mention.

lines.text: Set aside the ordinary headlines! {winner} has a European trophy to put above the season's noise.
Follow the European trail all the way to {winnerClub}, and you'll find silver at the end.
lines.was: With this cup, {winnerClub} have turned a European adventure into a proper piece of club history!

lines.text: Take a second to appreciate that achievement. A European tournament won, a special honour secured.
lines.was: That is the sort of European honour a manager can point to long after a season ends.

lines.text: And what a finish to this European chapter for {winner}: the Europa League trophy itself!
Nothing cryptic about the headline: {winnerClub} have lifted the Europa League trophy.
lines.was: There's no mistaking the prize {winnerClub} have claimed. European competition winners, right there in print.

lines.text: Let the rivalry take notice! {winner} has brought home continental silverware, and the answer must be worthy.
Be proud of this one, {winnerClub}. A continental title belongs beside the club's finest achievements.
lines.was: A silver reminder of European ambition has arrived, and it belongs to {winnerClub}!

lines.text: Just look at {winner} now: from European contender to Europa League winner. That's quite a leap.
lines.was: For once, the travel talk can stop. {winner} has reached the destination every Europa League contender wanted!

lines.text: On this stage, a European trophy is the ultimate answer. {winnerClub} have given it.
lines.was: On the European stage, {winnerClub} have earned something that cannot be talked away: a title.

lines.text: Say it with feeling, {winner}: Europa League champions! That is a wonderful phrase to own.
Hold the celebrations for just a moment: {winnerClub} have made this European honour theirs.
lines.was: There will be plenty to discuss later; for {winnerClub}, this moment belongs to European glory.

lines.text: Signing off from Europe with a title, {winner} has found a remarkable way to mark this season.
lines.was: The European campaign has its final signature, and {winner} has signed it with silverware!

lines.text: If a season needed a defining image, {winnerClub} lifting the Europa League would certainly do it.
Leave the ordinary compliments behind. {winner} has won a European competition. That says more than praise.
lines.was: An important entry in the honour roll for {winner}: champions of a major European competition!

lines.text: Across the continent, that trophy carries its own respect. {winnerClub} now hold the Europa League.
lines.was: What a way to give this season an international flavour! {winnerClub} have claimed the Europa League.

lines.text: Every mile carries a better memory when it ends with a title. {winner} has earned that one.
lines.was: Suddenly every European mile feels worthwhile. {winner} has a title to show for the journey!

lines.text: Behold the prize at the end of this continental pursuit: the Europa League, won by {winnerClub}!
Some triumphs fit into a brief report. This one demands the words Europa League champions in full.
lines.was: A European trophy changes the way a campaign is remembered. This one has found its rightful owner!

lines.text: For {winner}, this European honour is a lovely new talking point in a rivalry that never runs short of them.
lines.was: Behind the familiar rivalry, here is an achievement worth respecting from either side of the divide.

lines.text: Keep this well above the footnotes. The Europa League is an honour deserving of a headline.
lines.was: You don't put an honour like this in the footnotes! The Europa League demands a headline.

lines.text: Pack away the passport if you like; the continental distinction is staying out on display.
lines.was: The passport may go back in the drawer, but this continental distinction is going nowhere.

lines.text: Starting with a European ambition and ending with a trophy. That's how you finish the story properly.
lines.was: What began as a European challenge has finished with the kind of reward you can actually lift!

lines.text: Dreams are easy to put on paper. This one made it all the way into a winner's hands.
lines.was: Plenty of dreams stay on paper. This one has made it all the way to the trophy stand!

lines.text: An entire continental pursuit, and then the simplest sight of all: the competition's trophy, secured.
lines.was: There is no better answer to a long continental chase than seeing the silver at the end.

lines.text: Above the season's usual arguments sits something that requires no debate: Europa League winners.
lines.was: And here comes the part that lasts: Europa League winners, an achievement beyond the final season standings!

lines.text: Feel the weight of that honour. A continental title carries much more than the silver it's made of.
lines.was: What a beautiful weight to bring back from a European campaign. The weight of an earned title!

lines.text: At last, we have an answer to the Europa League question. Here is its new champion.
lines.was: At last, the continental question has its answer. The Europa League has a new home!

lines.text: What a finish to a European journey! The prize is real, and the satisfaction will last.
lines.was: The journey was European, the prize is permanent, and the celebration is entirely deserved!

lines.text: Even {loser} can appreciate the scale of that achievement. Europe doesn't award this trophy for good intentions.
lines.was: Even a friendly rival must tip the hat to that. A continental competition has been won!

lines.text: Forget the postcards. The best souvenir from a European campaign is the honour you can put on display.
lines.was: Forget the postcards; this is the keepsake every manager wants from a campaign across Europe!

lines.text: Between wanting this prize and holding it lies an entire campaign. That distance has been covered.
lines.was: The prize has crossed from possibility into possession, and the European chapter closes in triumph!

lines.text: It's not a consolation, it's a continental crown in its own right. A remarkable achievement!
The destination hardly matters when the prize means this much: a European title, won and treasured.
lines.was: Different country, different challenge, same wonderful conclusion: a European honour secured!

lines.text: Think of this as a season with a different signature. The Europa League trophy has signed it.
lines.was: There are trophies that decorate a season and trophies that give it an entirely new identity!

lines.text: Keep the cabinet door open! A distinguished piece of European silver is on its way!
Well, the continental adventure has an ending worthy of its ambition. And it comes in silver.
lines.was: Well, the continental adventure has an ending worthy of its ambition. Europa League glory!

lines.text: You can be proud of a European campaign without winning it. Winning it, though, is something else.
lines.was: Every club wants a place in Europe's conversation. Winning this competition makes a compelling case!

lines.text: Not merely a place in the competition's story, but the final word. That's what a title gives you.
lines.was: This isn't merely a good European showing; it's the ultimate prize that this competition can offer!

lines.text: Wait until that honour goes on the club record. The Europa League, won outright!
To see the trophy is to know what all the effort was for. A wonderful European success.
lines.was: It takes an entire campaign to earn a moment this simple: lift the trophy, cherish the title!

lines.text: Nobody has to dress that up. A European competition has been won, and that is substantial!
Try fitting an entire continental triumph into the margins of a season review. You can't.
lines.was: Try fitting this one into an ordinary season summary. Continental glory rarely stays in the margins!

lines.text: One pursuit has been settled in the best possible way. The Europa League trophy has an owner.
lines.was: One ambition has been settled beyond argument: the Europa League trophy has been claimed!

lines.text: Have you ever seen an ambition become so wonderfully simple? A European prize, at last secured.
lines.was: How many seasons get to finish a European journey with silverware? This one does!

lines.text: Others can chase it next season. This Europa League title already has its owner, and that won't change.
lines.was: There will be another campaign, another challenge, but this Europa League title cannot be taken back.

lines.text: No need for any grand introduction. Just take in the honour of winning the Europa League.
lines.was: No special effects needed here. The continental prize itself makes quite enough of a spectacle!

lines.text: Tomorrow the friendly argument returns. Today, a European title has earned a moment of respect.
lines.was: The rivalry can resume its usual teasing tomorrow. Right now, European success deserves its applause!

lines.text: Nobody's going to complain about making room in the cabinet for a trophy won beyond domestic football.
lines.was: A trophy earned beyond domestic competition, and a new kind of pride for the cabinet!

lines.text: Ask what makes a continental journey worthwhile. Coming back with the competition's highest reward will do.
lines.was: The sweetest part of a continental adventure? Coming back with the reason you went in the first place!

lines.text: Once the season fades, this European honour will still stand exactly where it was won.
An excellent place to end the sentence, and the season's European story: with the Europa League.
lines.was: You can put a full stop on that campaign. The Europa League trophy is the punctuation!

lines.text: Picture that next entry in a manager's career: won in Europe, came home carrying silverware.
lines.was: What an extraordinary line in any manager's story: went into Europe and came back a champion!

lines.text: Europe set the challenge. The response came with an impressive piece of silver attached.
lines.was: The continent offered a challenge; the answer is there in polished silver. A title won!

lines.text: You'd struggle to find a better proof of continental achievement than the actual Europa League trophy.
lines.was: If you needed evidence of a season well spent, a Europa League trophy is hard to overlook!

lines.text: Quietly or loudly, it means the same thing: a Europa League campaign has ended in success.
lines.was: All of a sudden, the season has a European headline that needs no further explanation!

lines.text: Raise that piece of silver! This was a competition worth winning, and now it has been won!
Make a little space in the club's own history. The Europa League has arrived.
lines.was: The honour has a name, the Europa League, and that name is going straight into the club's history!

lines.text: You can chase the feeling of a successful European campaign. Or you can lift the trophy and feel it.
lines.was: Something special happens when an international ambition ends with a tangible reward. This is it!

lines.text: Let the domestic comparisons wait their turn. There's a European title to appreciate right here.
lines.was: Give the domestic debate a rest for a moment. Continental success has earned the entire spotlight!

lines.text: Let that title stand without qualification: Europa League winners. An achievement that speaks for itself.
lines.was: You'll find no asterisk beside that achievement: Europa League winners, in their own right!

lines.text: Flip through the season's memories, and this trophy is the page nobody will want to skip.
lines.was: The season's scrapbook has gained a page far too important to tuck away at the back!

lines.text: Hold on to this feeling. Winning in Europe is an achievement that doesn't come along casually.
lines.was: Don't rush past this. A European title is not the sort of thing you collect every day!

lines.text: Boil down the whole adventure and you're left with the finest words: Europa League winners.
lines.was: An entire campaign distilled into a few wonderful words: winners of the Europa League!

lines.text: Cabinet space is a lovely problem to have when another European title is coming in.
lines.was: The kind of trophy that starts arguments about cabinet space and ends them with a smile!

lines.text: Take the applause, take the honour, and take home a prize from beyond the home league!
Trace a line across the map and it leads here: the destination was continental silverware.
lines.was: For this club, the map of Europe now has a very special destination: the winners' podium!

lines.text: Nothing borrowed about this glory. The Europa League trophy belongs to its winners, proudly and properly.
lines.was: Nothing borrowed about this glory. The Europa League title is theirs to keep, proudly and properly!
